messages:
irene.design: shared a fresh IA variant that clusters nav by user intent (Explore / Serve / Observe). Figma: https://figma.redwood/console/intent-cluster-v1 — primary goal: clearer discovery + deterministic deep links.
sam.pm: looks promising. Key requirement: do not break existing bookmarks. If we relocate 'Models' it must still resolve.
jay.frontend: plan: keep canonical paths and support legacy aliases. Add server middleware that normalizes incoming routes. During experiment we'll return 302 + show a migration banner; after stability switch to 301 and keep alias logs for a grace period.
umar.platform: telemetry: capture `legacy_segment`, `canonical_path`, and `redirect_count`. Retain logs 60 days and surface a weekly report for PMs.
lucy.a11y: accessibility concern: when groups collapse/reorder focus can get lost. After any client-side IA mutation set focus to the nearest visible nav item and emit an aria-live short message: "Navigation updated, focus moved to <label>." Ensure group headers use `aria-expanded` and are keyboard toggles.
irene.design: breadcrumbs should reflect the resource hierarchy (`Org / Workspace / Section`) not verbs. For quick actions, add compact chips to the right of the breadcrumb bar.
sam.pm: copy tweak: use U+203A (›) as the visual separator, aria-hidden, and ensure the nav landmark has a clear `aria-label`.
jay.frontend: implementation notes: add `data-legacy-path` attributes to nav items to help the middleware map client-side and server-side. Add a subtle toast on redirect: "Old link redirected to new location. Click to copy new URL." Also show a migration banner: "You're viewing this page via a migration mapping. Update bookmark? [Copy link]"
umar.platform: routing contract proposal: `/console/:org/:workspace/:section/:resourceId` + optional query params for ephemeral UI state (e.g., `?panel=metrics&focus=logs`). Avoid relying on hash fragments for crucial navigation state.
lucy.a11y: agreed on avoiding hashes; many assistive tools don't treat fragment navigation as a full route change. Also include screenreader-friendly wording for the migration banner.
irene.design: rollout plan: internal dogfood -> 20% experiment -> 100% rollout with 30d redirect monitoring -> deprecation notice for legacy segments. We'll also provide an in-app way to copy the new canonical link after redirect.
sam.pm: add an experiment flag gate and a metric dashboard for discoverability and bookmark failure rate. Alert if redirect spikes for any org.
jay.frontend: dev tasks: alias mapping table, middleware normalize + redirect, redirect telemetry, migration banner + toast + copy-to-clipboard, aria-live announcements, focus reconciliation. ETA 3 dev days + 1 QA.
lucy.a11y: I'll prepare a checklist: keyboard navigation, SR walkthrough, focus order after reflow, contrast checks, aria-live message phrasing.
umar.platform: I'll wire the feature flag and add the redirect telemetry streams.
tracker-bot: Created ticket RED-8213: "Intent-cluster rail IA: aliases, redirects, breadcrumb contract & a11y checklist" assigned to jay.frontend, omar.platform; due 2026-08-05. :white_check_mark:
